answer: Every identity that joins the economy must first plant a kernel: a small on-chain program declaring how it will behave before it ever transacts. The lotus rule wraps that kernel in layers — attest rights open one by one, each only after the last survived a full epoch without a disputed transaction. When a cluster of fresh identities blooms in one epoch from a single funder, their kernels never mature: the audit of their origins decides each fate, a confirmed fake forfeits 7,500 POA, and honest seedlings flower into full standing — the fable every newcomer is told at onboarding.
